The hook-in unit's design note, before any code (hold 36's shape, plus your GO's item 3): ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/hookin/DESIGN-NOTE.md. It is built on the stack's bank. Four questions, each with my rec:

Q1. lib/config's value rule for release.legs needs the plain-word test, and lib/config cannot source lib/release.legs. Rec (a): move release_leg_plain_word into lib/helpers as is_plain_word, one definition that both call. (b) would be a copy.

Q2. macOS declared on a host whose word is not macos. Rec (a): pre-flight refuses, naming the stage and the host's word, as AC-6.3 refuses a gate active on no leg. (b) would read it as absent, like an unreachable host.

Q3. How the macOS stage names its cache artefact. Rec (a): the build.artefacts entry whose path is macos.app's, with no new key, and doctor naming two entries that match one app. (b) would add a macos.artefact key.

Q4. release.yml (on v* tags; it publishes the GitHub Release). Rec: it stays out of this unit, and WP04's piece is tests.yml's tag filter and candidate-verdict job, with ci-workflow.bats's arms. Say if you want release.yml here.

The rest, in brief:
- release.legs hosts: reach at pre-flight; a reached host is legs.<host>; an absent host is named, recorded none, and never waited for.
- macos: where commands.macos.enabled is true, app-sign then app-notarize at R, under a MACOS seal of its own, in the cut's process group as the local gates run.
- app-sign: cache get before macos.build and cache put after it.
- The cut: one cache<TAB><artefact><TAB><key> line in the RELEASE seal for each artefact used, its key from cache key --commit R, and one printed line per artefact.
- Devbin's config declares release.legs: [kovacs].
- The arms are AT-2.7, AT-3.3 and AT-3.6.

The stack: lint gate r2 at a2bf88ba gave 57 files and 0 breaches; the scans are clean; AT-6.1 and AT-6.2 are minted to-write (60ce1c1c). The settle's critic review is running, and then come the squash, the red clone, the bank and the ask.
